localEmulatorProcessPartition.coverageInvariant: Every test selected by each official build is executed; the persistence build's two persistence modes run in separate browser processes.
localEmulatorProcessPartition.diagnosticControl: Chrome 151 reproduced the cross-persistence one-minute HTTP/1.1 WebChannel stall against official Java v1.22.0 and Fireside; each isolated persistence mode passed.

observations: The official workflow builds and runs the minified integration package, not the packages/firestore legacy source bootstrap.
Client memory and IndexedDB persistence are compiled and executed in separate workflow jobs.
The package copies Google's API integration tests while excluding its three pipeline-specific suites.
For a local plaintext emulator, browser-process partitioning preserves the official selected workload while avoiding a Chrome transport-pool stall that reproduces against the official Java emulator.
